findings.finding: Both saved registration and summary files match compact provenance. Registered source and new-artifact hashes, legacy response/direct binaries, baseline recipes, case files and snapshots are checked before use. All 36 recorded input bindings independently rehashed. Sequential regeneration preserves supplied intervals and source order; all six prefix observation digests reproduce. Anchor x=mean+Lw is checked. No source recentering, posterior recycling or observation duplication enters inference.

H2/c22/tensor/TaylorH2/H7 are constructed through HField with the same original centre, Taylor RC binary, three RC coefficients, prior and support. R5_H7 is separately labeled. Runner reads only direct and Taylor2_H2 frozen selected anchors and never invokes a fitter. Prior fit selection is by numerical fit diagnostics/objective from public starts, not truth. Hidden plant state belongs to deterministic fixture generation; streamed truth outputs are discarded. Both control endpoint states match original snapshots bitwise. All 24 previous control metric records and anchor metadata match exactly under explicit schema-only controls-key mapping.

Jacobian defects are partitioned in independent amplitudes/log-rates before K=B^-1 L maps them to prior coordinates. RC/H cross interactions and one identity prior are retained. The common augmented 51-column QR preserves residual, Jacobian and both defect inner products. Cost/gradient defects use the residual split, and unchanged columns are checked. New joint factors and saved control factors agree with augmented precision spectra to maximum scaled discrepancy 3.641368305905119e-11; maximum residual partition discrepancy is 4.578047060367629e-09 and maximum other-column defect is 2.234656903965515e-11, within declared numerical checks.

Taylor RC P2 and Taylor H H6 per-row derivative envelopes map through entrywise abs(K M) and sqrt(sum sigma^-2), a conservative Frobenius/spectral upper bound. Measured eta, epsilon=2 eta+eta^2, actual joint spectra and query inequalities remain distinct. All envelope consistency checks pass. At full multiscale Taylor anchor H6 eta upper is 153.30674899039957 while measured H eta is 0.24874325816077353; report correctly rejects usefulness as a runtime gate. Floating diagnostics are not outward-rounded or coverage certificates.

Inherited field features retain original computational box and physical trajectory checks; transported rejects invalid hysteresis/SOC endpoints without clipping. Direct model checks future trajectory support. Runner catches endpoint/future unsupported outcomes explicitly. All 216 saved-anchor hybrid transports and 432 hybrid forecasts happen to be supported; all 90 probe endpoint transports are supported. This finite success does not establish full-support polynomial transport. Direct transport forecasts isolate precision, while hybrid forecasts replace only the relevant RC/H state and full Jacobian rows; unchanged SOC and static parameters persist.

Six padding doubles remain counted; prospective 48 B saving is not credited. Desktop augmented root and chunk rows are separately reported as 20808 and 417792 B. These are component accounting, not aggregate live memory. Production runtime/defaults remain unchanged; target SRAM, CPU, lifetime, aging and coverage are unqualified.
